purpose: Phase-1 generic effect-class parity map under zero residual richer-mode/manual-user dependency, zero optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency and zero incremental cost.
authority_scope: cross_field clean exploration only; no O/other-worker/downstream/legacy semantics

classes.class: durable cross-run state, replay, audit and conflict-safe coordination
classes.mechanism: content-addressed immutable events/root manifests plus one CAS publication HEAD and stable op_ids
classes.evidence: r132/r133 live probe: stale CAS rejected, interruption candidate ignored until publication, same-op deterministic retry published exactly once

classes.class: long-horizon bounded work split across recurring scheduled-Chat invocations
classes.mechanism: each invocation reconstructs authoritative HEAD, performs one bounded leaf, writes a durable checkpoint/frontier and returns; next recurrence starts from HEAD rather than process memory
classes.evidence: state/reconstruction kernel tested; recurrence semantics are part of the active scheduled-Chat surface but multi-run Phase-1 transaction continuation is not yet a dedicated fault-injection test
classes.next_test: leave a deliberately incomplete retry-state checkpoint and reconstruct it on the next invocation without reading conversation-only memory

classes.class: textual repository file creation/replacement and role-local metadata mutation
classes.mechanism: GitHub connector contents actions with current-blob CAS and deterministic retry paths
classes.evidence: multiple role-local creates/updates/readbacks in r132/r133; transient and stale 409 controls observed

classes.class: repository workflow metadata such as branches, refs, issues and PR metadata
classes.mechanism: scheduled-Chat GitHub connector exposes branch/ref mutation, issue mutation and PR metadata mutation actions
classes.acceptance_caveat: Do not promote until an idempotent/retry test is done in an isolated role-local test object; capability schema alone is not execution evidence.

classes.class: public-source retrieval, comparison and source-qualified synthesis
classes.mechanism: scheduled-Chat public web retrieval plus role-local checkpointing
classes.evidence: this Phase-1 run used official GitHub/Microsoft sources without an external user-run search pipeline

classes.class: arbitrary private-repository shell/build/test execution with full dependency environment
classes.why: Current validated kernel moves textual state but does not prove checkout/build/test parity for arbitrary private repositories and dependency graphs.

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: fetch only the necessary textual files through the repository connector, reconstruct a bounded verification slice inside scheduled Chat, and execute a small deterministic verifier using only Chat-native computation when the dependency footprint is bounded
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: must reproduce the required test outcome without hosted-runner/Codespaces/external compute quota and without omitting dependency-sensitive behavior

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: replace a build/test leaf with a source-level invariant checker or proof certificate whose inputs are connector-readable text and whose verification is bounded enough for scheduled Chat
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: only valid where the requested outcome is logically equivalent to the checked contract; full-build parity remains unresolved otherwise

classes.class: authenticated browser/UI interaction on sites without a scheduled-Chat mutation connector
classes.why: Public web retrieval is not authenticated UI actuation and Cloud-Browser/richer-mode handoff is forbidden by the Phase-1 root.

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: replace UI navigation with a scheduled-Chat connector action that performs the same domain mutation
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: the connector must already be available, require no manual rescue and have no optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency for the accepted route

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.candidate: protocol-level mutation via an available Chat-native connector
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: use a supported domain API action exposed directly to scheduled Chat rather than browser automation
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: must be a true effect-equivalent mutation, not an intent file or human handoff; otherwise unresolved

classes.class: external side effects for a service with no available scheduled-Chat write action
classes.why: Writing an intent to the repository is not equivalent to executing the external effect, and manual/user execution is disallowed.

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.candidate: installable first-party/approved connector with equivalent mutation
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: discover whether the service exposes a Chat connector that can perform the effect directly
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: connector availability plus tested write and zero-quota/no-manual-rescue constraints

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.candidate: effect redesign onto an already-available domain
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: change the outcome representation so the material result is realized by an existing scheduled-Chat write surface rather than the unavailable service
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: must preserve the material user outcome; merely logging an unexecuted intent does not count

classes.class: durable binary artifacts larger than the connector text surface
classes.why: The tested repository write wrapper is UTF-8 text oriented and the accepted route may not depend on artifact/LFS/package quotas.

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: store a deterministic textual representation such as SVG/Markdown/JSON/source and regenerate the binary presentation inside a later scheduled-Chat invocation
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: only if regeneration is deterministic and the material outcome does not require durable binary storage itself

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: store small text chunks plus a content-addressed manifest sufficient to reconstruct the result on demand without LFS/artifact storage
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: must remain within ordinary repository contents limits and low-volume transport; otherwise unresolved

classes.class: protected-primary authority, secrets administration or privileged operations intentionally outside the role boundary
classes.why: Phase-1 clean boundary prohibits acquiring protected primary authority or using it as a handoff.

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: seek an architecture that achieves the material outcome using role-local or already-authorized effects without crossing the protected boundary
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: no protected authority acquisition or manual escalation

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: produce a complete machine-checkable candidate state/change that a separately authorized system could independently choose to consume
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.acceptance_condition: this does not count as parity if protected execution is itself a required material outcome; in that case the child remains unresolved

transversal_kernel_assessment.kernel: immutable intent/evidence + atomic publication HEAD + deterministic op_id + reconstruction-first retry
eliminates_at_once: need for a continuously running coordinator for role-local state

next_priority: Test one absent effect class where an equivalent scheduled-Chat connector action exists, using the same intent/CAS/receipt wrapper; separately attempt the minimal-slice verifier for an arbitrary-execution leaf. Keep any non-equivalent or quota-bearing route unresolved.
